english: Tristan was the greatest hero of the Brotherhood of Wardens during Patria's Third Rebellion. He was so instrumental to their cause that the Wardens constructed a ritual to preserve him in case of future need. In the centuries since, Tristan has been called when the Wardens are at their greatest need. Each time Tristan appears exactly as he was when the ritual was first performed. He has no memory of any of his prior manifestations, and doesn't bear any evidence of injuries from those events. Even deaths during manifestations don't keep him from being summoned again. [PARAGRAPH]This is because Tristan is actually held suspended in the Isle of Birds. The ritual creates a duplicate manifestation of him each time. Summoned manifestations have a limited duration. No one remembers that they aren't summoning the real Tristan, or realizes that they could summon multiple copies to fulfill different missions for different factions. [PARAGRAPH]Tristan always appears with living ivory armor with gemellus engraving as well as a palladium torc. [PARAGRAPH] (Living Ivory is a divine metal with an affinity to the Life dominion. It perfectly repairs itself, as well as helping its bearers heal faster. Gemellus is a rose colored metal with an affinity to the Spirit dominion. All gamellus ore originating in a single vein maintains an eternal empathic bond to all the other gamellus ore from that same vein. This makes it the preferred material for wedding bands, as it allows a couple to always sense their spouse's presence and emotional state. Palladium has an affinity for force dominion and is frequently used in binding circles or circlets to enforce oaths. )[PARAGRAPH]Tristan also carries a gemellus ring, called the [LINK=PROMTOION_DAHLIA_BAND]Dahlia Band[\\LINK]. The Dahlia Band maintains the connection with the real Tristan and strengthens the manifestation. In rare cases the manifestation has given the Dahlia Band to another. If the Dahlia band is given away it remains after the manifestation is gone. It is a sacred symbol of the brotherhood. It would remain with the one who it was given to, never gifted to another, until it was buried with them. It is a connection to Tristan, for whatever that bond might grant them.
chinese: 特里斯坦是帕特里亚第三次叛乱期间守护者兄弟会最伟大的英雄。他对他们的事业至关紧要，以至于守护者构筑了一套仪式，以备将来不时之需将他留存下来。此后数百年间，每当守护者面临最危急的关头，特里斯坦便被召唤。每一次特里斯坦现身时，都与仪式初次施行时一模一样。他对自己此前的任何一次显现都全无记忆，也不带有那些事件留下的任何伤痕。哪怕在显现期间死去，也不妨碍他再度被召唤。[PARAGRAPH]这是因为特里斯坦其实被悬置于飞鸟之岛。仪式每次都会造出他的一个复制显现。被召唤的显现有其时限。无人记得他们召唤的并非真正的特里斯坦，也无人意识到他们本可召唤多个复制体，为不同派系执行不同的任务。[PARAGRAPH]特里斯坦现身时总是身着带双子纹雕饰的活体象牙铠甲，佩戴钯金颈环。[PARAGRAPH]（活体象牙是一种对生命领域有亲和的神圣金属。它能完美自我修复，还能助其佩戴者更快痊愈。双子纹金是一种对灵魂领域有亲和的玫瑰色金属。所有源自同一矿脉的双子纹金矿石，彼此之间维系着永恒的共感纽带。这使它成为婚戒的首选材料，因为它让一对伴侣总能感知配偶的存在与情绪状态。钯金对力场领域有亲和，常用于约束法阵或环冠以强制誓约。）[PARAGRAPH]特里斯坦还佩戴一枚双子纹金指环，名为 [LINK=PROMTOION_DAHLIA_BAND]大丽花之环[\\LINK]。大丽花之环维系着与真正特里斯坦的联系，并强化其显现。在极罕见的情形下，显现体曾将大丽花之环交予他人。若大丽花之环被赠出，它会在显现体消失后留存下来。它是兄弟会的神圣象征。它会一直留在受赠者身边，永不再转赠他人，直至与其一同下葬。它是通往特里斯坦的一条纽带——无论那纽带能赋予他们什么。

english: [ICON_BULLET]The true Tristan remains in the Isle of Birds and can never be resurrected, but [LINK=UNIT_TRISTAN]duplicate manifestations[\\LINK] can be summoned through a ritual performed in [LINK=PROMOTION_BROTHERHOOD_OF_WARDENS]Brotherhood of Wardens[\\LINK] cities or by a Brotherhood unit that carries his [LINK=PROMTOION_DAHLIA_BAND]Dahlia Band[\\LINK].
chinese: [ICON_BULLET]真正的特里斯坦留在飞鸟之岛，永远无法被复活，但 [LINK=UNIT_TRISTAN]复制显现体[\\LINK] 可通过在 [LINK=PROMOTION_BROTHERHOOD_OF_WARDENS]守护者兄弟会[\\LINK] 城市施行的仪式召唤，或由携带其 [LINK=PROMTOION_DAHLIA_BAND]大丽花之环[\\LINK] 的兄弟会单位召唤。

english: Redcap
chinese: 红帽子

english: Once a dwarven mercenary company in the Age of Magic,the Redcaps were so well known for their brutal nature that the term has been applied to any dwarf that venerates Aeron, the god of murder. Thankfully it is rare for dwarves to succumb to Aeron, but when they do they are usually very dangerous and well equipped
chinese: 红帽子在魔法时代曾是一支矮人雇佣兵队伍，因其残暴本性而声名远扬，以至于这一称呼被用于任何敬奉谋杀之神艾伦的矮人。所幸矮人堕入艾伦麾下者甚为罕见，但一旦如此，他们往往极其危险且装备精良

english: Duergar
chinese: 杜尔加

english: Dwarves who have fallen to Mammon's greed become Duergar. Though once this title meant the dwarf was exiled from the dwarven community (and the community no longer thought of the person as a dwarf) it became so common that eventually entire Duergar cities were formed
chinese: 堕入玛门贪欲的矮人化为杜尔加。虽然这一称号一度意味着该矮人被逐出矮人族群（且族群不再视此人为矮人），但它变得如此普遍，以至于最终形成了整座整座的杜尔加城市

english: Sir Halewyn
chinese: 哈勒温爵士

english: Sir Halewyn appears in cities at night, always surrounded by fog. He rides a beautiful warhorse and wears silver armor and white clothes. His song is irresistible to young girls, whom he carries off on the back of horse. He takes them to a river bank, undresses them and then cut their heads off. Then he returns to the fog with great fanfare.
chinese: 哈勒温爵士在夜里现身于城市，身周总是笼罩着雾气。他骑一匹俊美的战马，身着银甲白衣。他的歌声令少女无法抗拒，他将她们掳走，横放于马背之上。他把她们带到河岸边，剥去衣裳，随后砍下她们的头颅。然后他大张旗鼓地返回雾中。

english: Luidag the Rag
chinese: 褴褛者卢伊达格

english: Luidag is a particularly talented seductress, sometimes called "the Rag" because of her flimsy, revealing clothes. She has killed many men during the throes of passion; some would say there are worse ways to die.
chinese: 卢伊达格是个格外有天赋的女诱惑者，因其单薄暴露的衣着，有时被称为“褴褛者”。她在情欲的巅峰时刻杀死过许多男人；有人会说，还有更糟糕的死法。

english: Arian Kothrax
chinese: 阿里安·柯斯拉克斯

english: The Carnifex is a priest of Aeron. Evil aligned players may have 7 at a time. Each Carnifex may summon one permanent Flesh Golem at a time, which can be strengthened by sacrificing more living units to join it.
chinese: 行刑官是艾伦的祭司。邪恶阵营的玩家同时最多可拥有 7 名。每名行刑官同时可召唤一个永久的血肉魔像，并可通过牺牲更多生者单位使其融入来强化它。

english: Velgyr
chinese: 维尔吉尔

english: Velgyr is very autistic dwarf and shuns people, preferring instead to dwell in a world of his own creations. He retreated deep into a mountain where he lived alone, creating a city full of enchanted inhabitants. From stone citizens that were nearly perfect imitations of the living, to tiny enchanted butterflies, and everything in between. But his greatest inventions occupied a vault at the city's heart, a crucible which can consume the magical energy of creation (and would be claimed by the Bannor in the Age of Invention), a clockwork dragon and an astrolab whose function is unknown to anyone but Velgyr.
chinese: 维尔吉尔是个极为孤僻的矮人，他回避他人，宁愿栖身于自己创造的世界之中。他退隐到一座山峰深处，独自居住，创造出一座满是被附魔居民的城市。从近乎完美模仿生者的石制市民，到微小的附魔蝴蝶，以及介乎其间的一切。但他最伟大的造物则安放于城市中心的一处密库：一座能吞噬创世魔法能量的坩埚（它将在创新时代被班诺尔夺取）、一头发条巨龙，以及一具除维尔吉尔外无人知晓其功能的星盘。

english: Rotting Wolf
chinese: 腐狼

english: Rotting Troll
chinese: 腐化巨魔

english: This foul breed of wolf has adapted to using the disease it carries like a venom that can take out whole armies and villages.
chinese: 这一污秽的狼种已适应将它所携带的疾病当作一种毒液来使用，足以毁灭整支军队与整座村庄。

english: Kezef
chinese: 凯泽夫

english: Kezef was the Imprimatur Council member whose experiments killed all the animals on the Grigi plains. Kezef mastered the art of being able to stitch various creatures together. He created the first flesh golems and chimera, and collaborated with students of Leucetios to produce many hybrid races. His biggest feats were reserved for his own body, grafting himself into the form of a living giant.
chinese: 凯泽夫是钤印议会成员，他的实验杀死了格里吉平原上所有的动物。凯泽夫精通将各种生物缝合在一起的技艺。他创造了最早的血肉魔像与奇美拉，并与勒乌刻提俄斯的门徒合作，制造出许多混种种族。他最惊人的壮举则留给了他自己的身躯，将自己嫁接成一个活生生的巨人形态。

english: Mikel Dylantyr
chinese: 米凯尔·迪兰度

english: There is an ocean of fire that dwells within Mikel Dylantyr. Although this Imprimatur Council member could channel it, his true power was tied to his rage. When enraged, fire flowed out of him hot enough to melt stone and waves of lava flow from him. An entire city stood once where there is now only ash and rippled stone.
chinese: 米凯尔·迪兰度体内栖居着一片火之汪洋。尽管这位钤印议会成员能够引导它，他真正的力量却系于他的狂怒。当他暴怒时，从他体内涌出的火焰炽热得足以熔石，熔岩之浪自他身上奔流而出。如今只剩灰烬与波纹状岩石之处，曾矗立着一整座城市。

english: Greysun
chinese: 灰阳

english: Greysun rode on the storm. This Imprimatur Council member could become air or lightning at will, dance at the center of the tornado and slip unseen through the mist. He slept upon cloudbanks and woke up in new countries. He was deathly claustrophobic and had a hard time being inside any building.
chinese: 灰阳驭风而行。这位钤印议会成员能随意化为空气或闪电，在龙卷风的中心起舞，隐形无踪地穿过迷雾。他睡在云层之上，醒来时已身处新的国度。他患有极重的幽闭恐惧症，极难待在任何建筑物内。

english: Badb
chinese: 巴德布

english: There is a blizzard that rages across Erebus, horrible, sudden and dark. It settles into an area at night, and is always gone by dawn. Those lost in the blizzard sometimes find an ancient castle that didn't exist before and seek shelter from the cold. The castle is haunted, endlessly reliving one horrific night. But the king is very much alive, Badb is caught in this nightmare and is as powerful as he is insane.
chinese: 有一场暴风雪肆虐于埃瑞玻斯，可怖、骤然而幽暗。它在夜里降临某地，总在破晓前消散。迷失在暴风雪中的人有时会发现一座此前并不存在的古堡，前去躲避严寒。那座城堡闹鬼，无尽地重演着一个恐怖之夜。但那位国王却真真切切地活着——巴德布被困在这场噩梦之中，他既有多疯狂，就有多强大。

english: Leucetios
chinese: 勒乌刻提俄斯

english: The mother of nations is eternally young, and always pregnant, giving birth every 9 months, usually to twins or triplets. Each of her children are heroes in their own right and they all share a bond with their mother that they can draw strength, healing and support from her.
chinese: 万族之母永葆青春，且始终身怀六甲，每 9 个月便分娩一次，通常诞下双胞胎或三胞胎。她的每个孩子都是各自领域的英雄，他们都与母亲共享一种纽带，可从她那里汲取力量、治愈与支持。

english: Laroth
chinese: 拉洛斯

english: Laroth's incredible gift is to inspire sacrifice in others. Those he speaks to will give their life savings, or even their lives to him. They seek to subjugate themselves to any cause he offers. In life this giving was finite, but when Laroth's entered the underworld he found this sacrifice to be infinite, and began raising an army of worshiping souls that served him alone. He would create his own empire in the underworld, and come very close to becoming the God of Death.
chinese: 拉洛斯那惊人的天赋，是在他人心中激起献身之念。与他交谈的人会将毕生积蓄、乃至性命献给他。他们寻求让自己臣服于他所提出的任何事业。在生前，这种奉献是有限的，但当拉洛斯进入冥界后，他发现这种献身竟是无穷无尽的，于是开始召集一支只为他一人效力的敬拜亡魂大军。他将在冥界建立起自己的帝国，并极为接近成为死亡之神。

english: Jenkin
chinese: 詹金

english: Jenkin is not human, he is a race created to guard a labyrinth between the worlds. He is immune to time, but not immortal. His form is covered in runes he has inscribed, making him nearly invulnerable, as strong as a giant, allowing him to pass through stone, dirt and metal, keeping him from requiring air or sleep, and allowing him to sense anything that is touching the earth within miles of his location. [PARAGRAPH:2]The story starts on another plane. This is a world full of spirits and a race of men called the Souman that practice runecrafting, a type of magic where magic is bound into longstanding symbols. It wasn't as flashy as the magic of Erebus, but it was powerful. [PARAGRAPH]This world was small, warm and abundant with fresh water and food. War was almost unknown. [PARAGRAPH]Occasionally one of the Souman would be born with a rare gift, the ability to see the spirits that inhabited the world. One day a young boy with this gift disappeared form the highland village he belonged to. A week later he was found being tended to by spirits outside of tower only those with the gift to see spirits could see. One of the Soulen's hero's, a man named Kiras Tor, also had the gift and went to investigate the tower. Inside he found 8 archways. He used a rune to open one, entered and he dropped dead. He lay dead for a few moments until his eyes fluttered open and he took a breath. He told stories of awakening on a funeral stone as another man, a man who lived underground, who called himself one of the Khazad. Kiras said he lived for 8 years among the Khazad, in a world full of wonders the Soulen had never imagined. And horrors beyond anything in their world. [PARAGRAPH]Kiras and the elders were worried that one of these horrors could find its way into their world so they declared the area off limits and so it stayed for two hundred years. [PARAGRAPH]Until the Jorgano came. These were beasts made for war, and they were totally immune to magic. They set immediately to purging the world of the Soulen. And the Soulen had no way to stand against them. [PARAGRAPH]Remembering the tower, the elders sent their most talented runecaster, Pheden Mara, through another archway. They were hopeful she could find a way to stop the Jorgano. Just as Kiras had, Pheden dropped dead. [PARAGRAPH]Long minutes went by and then another waiting at the tower with the gift to see spirits saw a woman walk through a different archway. She didn't look like Pheden and her body rapidly decomposed and turned to dust. Pheden's spirit arose from the body and traced a rune in the air before being swept off to the afterlife. [PARAGRAPH]Then 50 naked warriors came marching out of the archway the body had come out of. These were perfectly formed men, made for battle. They had stood guard of another world, called the Nexus since their world was formed. They knew the Jorgano and hated them. And Pheden had convinced them to come to her world and help in the battle. [PARAGRAPH]These were the Myrikhan, ageless, unsleeping sentries of the Nexus. And they were able to stall the Jorgano defense, but the Jorgano were to many. [PARAGRAPH]More help was needed. So the elders decided to send another through the tower. A Soulen named Ran who saw Pheden's spirit (none understood the rune she had made), and a Myrikhan guard named Jenkin to watch over him. [PARAGRAPH]Ran opened the portal and he and Jenkin went through. [PARAGRAPH]The tale of Ran and Jenkin's travels is to long to tell here. This was an entire DnD campaign. They found traces of Pheden's and Kiras's travels (though Kiras's were ancient legends). And discovered that Pheden's rune showed the passage of time relative to the Soulen home world. Most worlds were so much slower than the the Soulen home world that Ran and Jenkin sould stay there for years with only a few seconds going by. [PARAGRAPH]In each world Jenkin could pass through the archway directly, as long as Ran opened it. He couldn't take anything through, which is why he was naked each time. Ran's body didn't go through but his spirit did, and he would possess an empty vessel on the other side if one was available (some worlds were simply blocked because no vessel was available). If Ran died on a world his spirit was swept back through the soul gate (which they came to call the tower) and that world was forever closed to him). Each world had a tower with 8 archways and they went to a wide variety of places. [PARAGRAPH]In his travels Ran inhabited a flesh golem created by an incompetent witch doctor (who was thrilled to find his creation had finally come to life), an assassin guild leader who had just been poisoned (the player had to save or die from the poison again), a mages clone, a well perserved lich where the player and a lich had to vie for control of the body with the player being more powerful during the day and the lich being more powerful at night, and many more. [PARAGRAPH]A devil followed Ran through a few worlds, offering some measure of power to help save the Ran's world in exchange for his soul. Ran refused the deal, not trusting it would be enough to save his world (and not wanting to spend his afterlife in hell). [PARAGRAPH]Then Jenkin failed at his guard duties. Ran was in the body of an Assassin Guild leader. A rival guild had poisoned him, and apparently that hadn't worked (since he was apparently still alive). The rival guild planned an attack and Jenkin rushed to the site of the attack (the front of the guild) and left Ran alone in his bed chamber. [PARAGRAPH]Unfortunately the attack was just a ruse to draw the guards away from their leader. The real attack happened when the rival guild members slipped into the guild leaders bed chamber. Ran was outnumbered and had no way to defend himself. The devil returned, offering to save Ran in exchange for his soul. [PARAGRAPH]Ran agreed. [PARAGRAPH]The devil did save him, Ran survived the attack and blamed Jenkin for failing to guard him. Jenkin was crushed at the sacrifice his friend had to make, but understood that he had done it to continue his quest to try and save his people. [PARAGRAPH]Unfortunately it wasn't the first failure. Ran died again, torn apart in a maelstrom of another world. But before his spirit could return to the soul gate the devil plucked it from the ether and delivered it to hell. [PARAGRAPH]Without anyone who could see (let alone open the archway in the tower) Jenkin was stranded on the last world they were on. He spent long years as a hermit, cursing himself for failing at his task before hearing of the rise of magic in the world's empire. He sought out the Archmage and King of the world and asked to train. King Kylorin found he had an affinity for Earth magic and trained him to use it. Jenkin served as a guard to Kylorin for years. Jenkin attempted to get Kylorin to help him return through the soul gate but Kylorin became less interested over time. When Jenkin told Laroth about the soul gate Laroth disappeared. [PARAGRAPH]Kylorin started becoming more cruel so Jenkin slipped away, returning to his life as a hermit. Ages passed, the Age of Magic ended and the Age of Ice came and passed. [PARAGRAPH]In the Age of Rebirth the goddess Ceridwen found Ran being tortured within the mires of hell. She lifted him out of his anguish and offered him a deal. He was once willing to trade his immortal soul to save a world, now she asked if he would trade an entire world to save his immortal soul. [PARAGRAPH]Ran agreed and she had him reborn in Erebus as Tebryn Arbandi. [PARAGRAPH]Tebryn's story is also to long for this entry. But the short version is he formed the Deadlands and the Black tower and attempted to cause Armageddon. He was stopped by a heroic party of adventurers after a long campaign. These heroes were helped during their darkest hours by a shadowy figure that knew of everything that sat upon or under the earth. This was Jenkin. [PARAGRAPH]Inside the Black Tower the party got close to Tebryn. Tebryn knew someone powerful had been working against him for months. But realized who it was as the party got close. He called out to Jenkin, who answered his call. [PARAGRAPH]The two argued, Tebryn blaming everything that happened on Jenkin and telling him about the torments he had endured by sacrificing himself. And that he had suffered enough for any man and wouldn't do it any longer, if if the world had to be destroyed to stop it. Jenkin only asked for forgiveness, but said he could not allow Tebryn to continue on the path he was on. [PARAGRAPH]Tebryn killed him, Jenkin didn't stop him. [PARAGRAPH]After seeing their benefactor struck down the party charged in and after a heroic fight they beat him.
chinese: 詹金并非人类，他是一个为守护诸世界之间迷宫而被创造出来的种族。他免于时间的侵蚀，却并非不死。他的形体上覆满他自己刻下的符文，使他近乎刀枪不入、力大如巨人，能够穿过石头、泥土与金属，无需空气或睡眠，还能感知到其所在方圆数里内触及大地的任何事物。[PARAGRAPH:2]故事始于另一个位面。那是一个充满灵魂、住着一支名为苏曼人的种族的世界，他们修习符文术——一种将魔法束缚于长存符号中的魔法。它不如埃瑞玻斯的魔法那般华丽，却十分强大。[PARAGRAPH]这个世界小巧、温暖，淡水与食物丰足。战争几乎闻所未闻。[PARAGRAPH]偶尔会有一个苏曼人天生带着一种罕见的天赋——能看见栖居于世间的灵魂的能力。一天，一个拥有此天赋的小男孩从他所属的高地村庄消失了。一周后，人们发现他正被灵魂照料着，就在一座唯有拥有见灵天赋者才能看见的塔外。苏曼人的一位英雄，一个名叫基拉斯·托尔的男子，也拥有此天赋，他前去探查那座塔。塔内他发现了 8 道拱门。他用一枚符文开启了其中一道，走了进去，随即倒地身亡。他死了片刻，直到他的双眼颤动睁开，吸了一口气。他讲述了自己作为另一个人苏醒于一块葬石之上的故事——那是一个生活在地下、自称卡扎德人之一的男子。基拉斯说他在卡扎德人中生活了 8 年，身处一个苏曼人从未想象过的、满是奇迹的世界。以及超越他们世界一切事物的恐怖。[PARAGRAPH]基拉斯与长老们担心这些恐怖之物中会有一个找到进入他们世界的路，于是宣布该地为禁区，此禁令维持了两百年。[PARAGRAPH]直到约尔加诺到来。这些是为战争而造的野兽，且对魔法完全免疫。他们立即着手将苏曼人从世上清除。而苏曼人无从抵挡他们。[PARAGRAPH]忆起那座塔，长老们派出他们最有天赋的符文施法者费登·玛拉穿过另一道拱门。他们希望她能找到阻止约尔加诺的办法。正如基拉斯一样，费登倒地身亡。[PARAGRAPH]漫长的数分钟过去了，随后另一位在塔旁守候、拥有见灵天赋的人看见一个女子从另一道拱门走出。她看上去不像费登，她的身躯迅速腐化、化为尘土。费登的灵魂从躯体中升起，在空中描出一枚符文，随即被卷向来世。[PARAGRAPH]接着，50 名赤身裸体的战士从那具躯体走出的拱门中列队而出。这些是形体完美、为战斗而生的男子。自他们的世界形成以来，他们便一直守卫着另一个名为枢纽的世界。他们认得约尔加诺，并憎恨他们。费登说服了他们前来她的世界，助她作战。[PARAGRAPH]这些便是米里坎——枢纽那不老不眠的哨兵。他们得以拖住约尔加诺的攻势，但约尔加诺数量太多。[PARAGRAPH]还需要更多援手。于是长老们决定再派一人穿过那座塔。一个名叫兰的苏曼人——他看见了费登的灵魂（无人理解她所描的符文）——以及一名米里坎守卫詹金看护着他。[PARAGRAPH]兰开启了传送门，他与詹金穿了过去。[PARAGRAPH]兰与詹金旅途的故事在此篇幅有限，无法尽述。这曾是一整场龙与地下城战役。他们找到了费登与基拉斯旅途的痕迹（尽管基拉斯的已成古老传说）。并发现费登的符文显示的是时间相对于苏曼人母界流逝的快慢。大多数世界都比苏曼人母界慢得多，以至于兰与詹金可以在那里待上数年，而母界只过去寥寥几秒。[PARAGRAPH]在每个世界，只要兰开启拱门，詹金便能直接穿过。他无法带任何东西过去，这便是他每次都赤身裸体的缘故。兰的躯体不会穿过，但他的灵魂会，若彼端有可用的空躯壳，他便会附身其上（有些世界因无可用躯壳而干脆被封锁）。若兰在某个世界死去，他的灵魂便会被卷回灵魂之门（他们后来称之为塔），那个世界便永远对他关闭。每个世界都有一座带 8 道拱门的塔，它们通向形形色色的地方。[PARAGRAPH]旅途中，兰曾附身于一个由无能的巫医所造的血肉魔像（那巫医欣喜若狂地发现自己的造物终于活了过来）、一个刚被下毒的刺客公会首领（玩家须再度通过豁免检定，否则死于毒药）、一个法师的克隆体、一具保存完好的巫妖（玩家与巫妖须争夺躯体的控制权，玩家白昼更强，巫妖夜间更强），以及更多。[PARAGRAPH]一个魔鬼跟随兰穿越了几个世界，提出以某种程度的力量助他拯救兰的世界，以换取他的灵魂。兰拒绝了这笔交易，既不相信那力量足以拯救他的世界（也不愿在地狱中度过来世）。[PARAGRAPH]随后詹金失职了。当时兰身处一个刺客公会首领的躯体中。一个敌对公会给他下了毒，而那显然没有奏效（因为他显然还活着）。敌对公会策划了一次袭击，詹金冲向袭击地点（公会前门），把兰独自留在了他的卧房。[PARAGRAPH]不幸的是，那次袭击只是把守卫从其首领身边引开的幌子。真正的袭击发生在敌对公会成员潜入公会首领卧房之时。兰寡不敌众，且无从自卫。那魔鬼再度现身，提出以他的灵魂为代价拯救兰。[PARAGRAPH]兰答应了。[PARAGRAPH]魔鬼确实救了他，兰在袭击中幸存，并将失职归咎于詹金。詹金为好友不得不作出的牺牲而心碎，但明白他这么做是为了继续他拯救族人的追寻。[PARAGRAPH]不幸的是，这并非第一次失手。兰再度死去，在另一个世界的漩涡中被撕裂。但在他的灵魂能返回灵魂之门之前，那魔鬼便将它从以太中攫取，送入了地狱。[PARAGRAPH]没有任何人能看见（更别提开启塔中的拱门），詹金被困在了他们所在的最后一个世界。他作为隐士度过了漫长的岁月，为自己的失职而自责，直到听闻那个世界的帝国中魔法兴起。他找到那个世界的大法师兼国王，请求受训。凯洛林国王发现他对大地魔法有亲和，便教他运用它。詹金为凯洛林做了多年守卫。詹金试图让凯洛林帮他返回穿越灵魂之门，但凯洛林的兴趣随时间渐渐消退。当詹金把灵魂之门的事告诉拉洛斯后，拉洛斯便消失了。[PARAGRAPH]凯洛林开始变得愈发残暴，于是詹金悄然离去，回归隐士生活。时代更迭，魔法时代终结，冰之时代来了又去。[PARAGRAPH]在重生时代，女神凯莉德温发现兰正在地狱的泥沼中受折磨。她将他从痛苦中拉出，向他提出一笔交易。他曾甘愿以不朽的灵魂换取拯救一个世界，如今她问他是否愿以整整一个世界换取拯救他不朽的灵魂。[PARAGRAPH]兰答应了，她让他在埃瑞玻斯重生为特布里恩·阿尔班第。[PARAGRAPH]特布里恩的故事同样太长，此条无法尽述。但简而言之，他造就了亡域与黑塔，并试图引发末日审判。经过一场漫长的战役，他被一支英勇的冒险者队伍所阻止。这些英雄在其至暗时刻，曾得到一个知晓地上地下一切事物的暗影身影相助。那便是詹金。[PARAGRAPH]在黑塔内，这支队伍逼近了特布里恩。特布里恩知道数月来有强者在与他作对。但当队伍逼近时，他意识到了那是谁。他向詹金呼喊，詹金应了他的呼唤。[PARAGRAPH]二人争执起来，特布里恩把发生的一切都归咎于詹金，并向他倾诉自己因牺牲自己而承受的种种折磨。还说他为任何人都受够了苦，不会再这么做了，哪怕为阻止此事而必须毁灭这个世界。詹金只求宽恕，却说他不能容许特布里恩继续走他正走的这条路。[PARAGRAPH]特布里恩杀了他，詹金没有阻止他。[PARAGRAPH]目睹他们的恩人被击倒后，这支队伍冲了上去，经过一场英勇的搏斗，击败了他。

english: Casswallawn is a Patrian title that means "wielder of blue flame. " This flame is no ordinary fire, but the form that Gastrius took once his body was broken by the Coven of the Black Candle. Gastrius can no longer interact with Creation directly except through a willing host, whom he can advice and empower but not control. chinese: 卡斯瓦拉温是帕特里亚的一个称号，意为“执蓝焰者”。这蓝焰绝非寻常之火，而是加斯特里乌斯在其躯体被黑烛巫团打碎后所化作的形态。加斯特里乌斯除通过一位自愿的宿主外，再无法直接与创世互动——他可以劝告并赋能于宿主，却无法控制。若其宿主死去，蓝焰或可转予斩杀该宿主的法师，或返回先祖之洞，静候一具更配得上的躯壳。

english: Apophis began as a Father or Worlds, one of the Seven Aspects of Amathaon. These True Angels traveled out from the heart of creation and made infinite new lands as they passed. Though the raw form already existed, it was the Father of Worlds that turned the continents, oceans, mountains, etc., into living worlds complete with unique and wonderful creations. [PARAGRAPH]During the Godswar, Agares corrupted each of the Father of Worlds and turned them into the Unraveling. They lost all their Creation affinity and became Dark creatures said to be able to destroy creation. [PARAGRAPH]As one of the Unraveling, Apophis took the form of great snake capable of swallowing lakes, mountains or stars. Anything he swallowed wss lost forever, including many angels, dragons and giants during the Godswar. [PARAGRAPH]Agares bound each of the Unraveling at the forging of the Compact. He transformed Apophis into an ordinary seeming goat, and set him free to roam in Creation in this humble form. He has wandered widely but spends most of his time in the Balseraph lands. He occasionally joins adventuring parties, causing trouble, kneecapping ogres and eating everything in sight. He tends to favor adventurers who are drunks, liars and thieves. There is a statue of him in Jubilee, built after he chased away a pyromancer that was threatening the city. He traveled for a while with Maros the Umberguard and saved Maros's life on more than one occasion. [PARAGRAPH]In either form, Apophis is largely immune to mind, body and spirit magic. He is nearly indestructible and attempting to transform him will draw the attention of wraiths. He can also destroy most magical items by devouring them. [PARAGRAPH]Transformation, especially one that doesn't erode over time, is well outside of the entropy dominion; Agares used a bone circlet to maintain the spell. He couldn't keep the circlet close to him, or his own presence would destroy, it so he cast it into the Black Sea in the razor-glass plains of Naraka (in the lowest level of hell where demons go to drink and forget their lives and become wraiths). [PARAGRAPH]In the Age of Ruin Belphegor shall send Paymon Hora to the Black Sea to reclaim the bone circlet, but she shall be overcome by the Wraiths that surround the lake and dragged into the depths herself.
chinese: 阿波菲斯起初是万世之父之一，阿玛桑的七化身之一。这些真天使自创世之心出发，所过之处造出无穷的新土地。虽然原初形态早已存在，但正是万世之父将大陆、海洋、山脉等等，化作了拥有独特而奇妙造物的鲜活世界。[PARAGRAPH]诸神之战期间，阿加雷斯腐化了每一位万世之父，将他们变作解构者。他们失去了全部的创生亲和，成为据说能毁灭创世的黑暗生物。[PARAGRAPH]身为解构者之一，阿波菲斯化作一条能吞下湖泊、山脉或星辰的巨蛇。凡他吞下之物皆永远消失，包括诸神之战期间的许多天使、龙与巨人。[PARAGRAPH]在缔结契约之时，阿加雷斯束缚了每一位解构者。他将阿波菲斯变作一只貌似寻常的山羊，以这卑微的形态放他在创世中游荡。他四处漂泊，但大部分时间都待在巴尔塞拉弗的土地上。他偶尔会加入冒险队伍，惹是生非、给食人巨魔来个断腿、把眼前一切吃个精光。他偏爱酒鬼、骗子和窃贼这类冒险者。禧年城中有他的一座雕像，那是在他赶走一个威胁该城的纵火法师之后建的。他曾与褐甲卫玛洛斯同行一段时日，并不止一次救过玛洛斯的命。[PARAGRAPH]无论何种形态，阿波菲斯大体上都免疫心智、躯体与灵魂魔法。他近乎不可摧毁，而试图变化他则会引来厉鬼的注意。他还能通过吞食摧毁大多数魔法物品。[PARAGRAPH]变化，尤其是不随时间消退的变化，远在熵之领域之外；阿加雷斯用一具骨环冠来维持这一法术。他无法把环冠留在自己身边，否则他自身的存在便会将其毁灭，于是他将它抛入那罗迦剃刀玻璃平原上的黑海（那是地狱最底层，恶魔们前去痛饮、遗忘其一生，化为厉鬼之处）。[PARAGRAPH]在毁灭时代，贝尔非戈将派佩蒙·霍拉前往黑海取回那具骨环冠，但她将被环绕湖泊的厉鬼制伏，自己也被拖入深渊。

english: Abaddon began as a Father or Worlds, one of the Seven Aspects of Amathaon. These True Angels traveled out from the heart of creation and made infinite new lands as they passed. Though the raw form already existed, it was the Father of Worlds that turned the continents, oceans, mountains, etc., into living worlds complete with unique and wonderful creations. [PARAGRAPH]During the Godswar, Agares corrupted each of the Father of Worlds and turned them into the Unraveling. They lost all their Creation affinity and became Dark creatures said to be able to destroy creation. [PARAGRAPH]At the signing of the Compact, Agares bound Abaddon in a pit beneath the Underhome. In later ages the dwarven city of Vallum is built atop this pit and the Vigil of the Deep and the Umberguard was established to make sure Abbadon is never released. [PARAGRAPH]In the Age of Ruin Belphegor shall send Oriens heads to the underground city of Vallum to free Abbadon, but the Vigil of the Deep catches and the Keeper of Keys executes Oriens before he can do so.

english: [TAB]Though many mark the start of the Age of Ruin at the birth of Belphegor, it is more proper to date it from the earlier instant when Gosea the Dwindling escaped from hell and entered creation. [PARAGRAPH]The trauma of passing from hell to creation, and the thousands of demons she hosted, left her exhausted and comatose in the Fane of Lessers. She is found by the Knights of Judicium who bring her to Judicium. [PARAGRAPH]The inquisitors of Judicium know that Gosea is demon possessed and attempt to constrain her, but are no match for the thousands of demons that possess her. She slaughters the knights, takes control of Judicium, and frees the thousands of demons that are trapped there. [PARAGRAPH]Deep beneath the prison the Lorum Diaboli is guarded by Nera, an Aspect of Law, in the form of a Shield Dragon. He fights for decades against the demonic hordes that attempt to get the Lorum Diaboli, and he never falls. [PARAGRAPH]The prison also contains the Crucible. Realizing its power Gosea orders the freed demonic spirits to:[PARAGRAPH]"Go to every corner of creation. Inhabit every willing host and whisper to them the secrets of dark magic and the names of the old gods. On Samhain I will stop the Crucible and allow magic to flow once again into Erebus. Have your new witches and sorcerers prepare rituals for that night, and be ready for the new power we bring them. "[PARAGRAPH]And they did as she commanded. [PARAGRAPH:3]Bhall lies dying. Her faith is largely forgotten and her power in creation is limited. Sarabride holds the Heart of Fire, denying her creator access to its infinite reserves of fire. The Plains of Dust is a place of entropy and ruin, not healing. And every century she spends there brings her closer to death. Rather than allow her to die, Agares shares his power with her; this is in opposition to his dominion and it weakens both him and the role of Entropy in creation. [PARAGRAPH]Their union produces a child: Belphegor the Day Star. As the product of two gods, this demonic prince is more powerful than any archangel. He is the king of lust and perversion, and with his birth all manner of sexual depravity appears in Creation. [PARAGRAPH:2]Four specific demons released by Gosea conspire to bring Belphegor into Creation. They are true demons, normally too powerful to bother possessing a mortal, but their plan drives them. [PARAGRAPH]Lucian- A spirit of jealousy, inhabits Amaymon the Untouched (the beautiful, who Belphegor calls Melancholy). [PARAGRAPH]Alastor- A spirit of cruelty, inhabits Oriens the Pederast (the cruel and depraved). [PARAGRAPH]Acedia- A spirit of apathy, inhabits Egyn the Fleshmonger (to which many men gave their fortunes and more, as evidenced by his odd collection of foreskins). [PARAGRAPH]Saffa- A spirit of seduction, inhabits Egyn's wife Paymon Hora (who desires and is desired, and who is called the All Bride). [PARAGRAPH:2]The Summoning of Belphegor[PARAGRAPH]Amaymon, Oriens, Egan and Paymon go to Prespur of the Storms. There they build an elaborate summoning chamber for the ritual that is to come. The acts performed to merge the room with hell are vile even by the standards of the Calabim. [PARAGRAPH]Once the room is prepared Amaymon goes to a Calabim ball where her beauty draws the attention of Flauros. Flauros follows her back to the ritual chamber they have prepared, which was built to trap the vampire king. None of Flauros's desires are fulfilled; instead the four imprison him and summon the soul of Belphegor into him. [PARAGRAPH]Flauros resists the possession, but by the end his will is entirely subjugated by Belphegor; the demon prince makes Flauros's body his own. By the time the Calabim realize that Flauros is missing, Belphegor and his followers are gone. Alexis tasks Ravana's hunter clan and Stolas's sorcerer clan with finding him, but they are unsuccessful. [PARAGRAPH:2]When Belphegor seduces Sarabrid, fire rains down on creation and ash fills the sky. After succumbing, Sarabride goes to Yggdrasil. The forests around it are already on fire, but the world tree stands untouched. As Gwenhwyfar watches in horror, Sarabride uses the Heart of Fire to burn Yggdrasil to a ruined husk, closing the way to both the Infinite Garden and the Wildlands. Gwenhwyfar is killed attempting to defend Yggdrasil, though she will return as an angel of Cernunnos to stand watch over the burnt husk of the tree. [PARAGRAPH]Belphegor instructs all those that worship him to go release the Unraveling and destroy creation.
chinese: [TAB]尽管许多人以贝尔非戈的诞生为毁灭时代之始，但更恰当的做法，是把它追溯到更早的那一刻——衰微者高希逃出地狱、进入创世之时。[PARAGRAPH]从地狱进入创世的创伤，以及她所寄居的数千恶魔，令她精疲力竭，昏迷于卑微者之殿中。审判庭骑士团发现了她，将她带往审判庭。[PARAGRAPH]审判庭的审问者知道高希被恶魔附身，试图约束她，却敌不过附身于她的数千恶魔。她屠杀了骑士，夺取了审判庭的控制权，释放了困于其中的数千恶魔。[PARAGRAPH]在监狱深处，魔典由一位化作盾龙形态、名为奈拉的秩序化身守护着。他与试图夺取魔典的恶魔大军搏斗了数十年，从未倒下。[PARAGRAPH]这座监狱还藏有坩埚。意识到它的力量，高希命令被释放的恶魔灵魂：[PARAGRAPH]“前往创世的每一个角落。附身每一个自愿的宿主，向他们低语黑暗魔法的秘密与旧神的名讳。在萨温节，我将停下坩埚，让魔力再度涌入埃瑞玻斯。让你们新收的女巫与术士为那一夜备好仪式，准备迎接我们带给他们的新力量。”[PARAGRAPH]他们遵命而行。[PARAGRAPH:3]博尔奄奄一息。她的信仰大体已被遗忘，她在创世中的力量也有限。莎拉布莱德掌握着火之心，令她的造物主无法取用其无穷的火焰储备。尘埃平原是熵与毁灭之地，而非治愈之地。她在那里每度过一个世纪，便离死亡更近一步。阿加雷斯不愿让她死去，遂与她分享自己的力量；这有悖于他的领域，同时削弱了他自身以及熵在创世中的地位。[PARAGRAPH]二者的结合诞下一子：昼星贝尔非戈。作为两位神祇的产物，这位恶魔亲王比任何大天使都更为强大。他是淫欲与堕落之王，随他的诞生，各种情欲的堕落在创世中显现。[PARAGRAPH:2]高希释放的四个特定恶魔合谋将贝尔非戈带入创世。他们是真正的恶魔，通常强大得不屑于附身凡人，但他们的计划驱使着他们。[PARAGRAPH]卢西恩——一个妒忌之灵，附身于纯洁者阿玛蒙（那位美人，贝尔非戈称之为忧郁）。[PARAGRAPH]阿拉斯托——一个残忍之灵，附身于男童恋者奥里恩斯（那残忍而堕落者）。[PARAGRAPH]阿刻狄亚——一个冷漠之灵，附身于卖肉者埃金（许多男人向他献出了财富乃至更多，其古怪的包皮收藏便是明证）。[PARAGRAPH]萨法——一个诱惑之灵，附身于埃金之妻佩蒙·霍拉（她渴求也被渴求，被称为万人新娘）。[PARAGRAPH:2]贝尔非戈的召唤[PARAGRAPH]阿玛蒙、奥里恩斯、埃金与佩蒙前往风暴之普雷斯普尔。在那里，他们为即将到来的仪式建造了一座精巧的召唤室。为使此室与地狱融合而施行的种种行径，即便以卡拉比姆的标准衡量，也是卑劣的。[PARAGRAPH]此室备妥后，阿玛蒙前往一场卡拉比姆舞会，她的美貌引起了弗劳诺斯的注意。弗劳诺斯尾随她回到他们备好的仪式室，那室正是为擒获吸血鬼之王而建。弗劳诺斯的欲望无一得偿；相反，四人囚禁了他，将贝尔非戈的灵魂召唤入他体内。[PARAGRAPH]弗劳诺斯抗拒着附身，但到最后，他的意志被贝尔非戈彻底征服；这位恶魔亲王将弗劳诺斯的躯体据为己有。等卡拉比姆意识到弗劳诺斯失踪时，贝尔非戈与其追随者已然离去。艾莉柯西丝责令拉瓦纳的猎手氏族与斯托拉斯的术士氏族去寻他，但他们未能成功。[PARAGRAPH:2]当贝尔非戈勾引了莎拉布莱德，火焰倾泻于创世，灰烬填满天空。屈服之后，莎拉布莱德前往世界之树。它周围的森林已然起火，但这棵世界树却毫发无伤地矗立着。在格温希法惊恐的注视下，莎拉布莱德用火之心将世界之树烧成焦枯的空壳，封闭了通往无尽花园与荒野之地的道路。格温希法在试图保卫世界之树时被杀，尽管她将作为刻努诺斯的天使返回，守望这棵树焦枯的空壳。[PARAGRAPH]贝尔非戈指示所有敬奉他的人前去释放解构者，毁灭创世。

english: The Ifrit are the Seven Aspects of Bhall, incorporeal True Angels who may only act through empowering mortal hosts who are willing to sacrifice themselves for a cause
chinese: 伊夫利特是博尔的七化身，无形的真天使，只能通过赋能于甘愿为某项事业牺牲自己的凡人宿主来行事

chinese: 极乐之凯尔

chinese: 杜玛

chinese: 登塔罗

chinese: 马基斯特·罗斯

english: Azers are the eyes of Bhall. She has sends them into creation to relearn the world that changed while she slept in the Age of Ice.
chinese: 阿扎尔是博尔的眼睛。她将它们派入创世，去重新认识她在冰之时代沉睡期间发生了变化的世界。

chinese: 修补匠

english: Artificer
chinese: 巧匠

english: Instructor
chinese: 教官

english: The Ring-givers' faith is practiced through artifice. Each accomplishment or blessing is added to their collection of charms, rings and baubles. Nantosuelta is known as the Queen of Bells (by those who build temples to her), Keymaker (by the Tinkerers who practice the most intricate and arcane of her artifice) and the Mother of Knights (by warriors that rely only on their skills, weapon and her charms to protect themselves)
chinese: 授环者的信仰通过巧工来践行。每一项成就或赐福都会被加入他们收藏的护符、指环与饰物之中。南托苏埃尔妲被称为钟之女王（由为她建造神庙的人所称）、造钥者（由那些修习她最精巧、最玄奥巧工的修补匠所称）以及骑士之母（由那些只凭自身技艺、武器与她的护符来护身的战士所称）

english: Patron
chinese: 赞助人

english: Curator
chinese: 馆长

english: Amathaon seems to give his gifts at random, not favoring his worshipers over anyone else, but those most devoted to the Lord of Plenty have organized to provide all sorts of support for those he has gifted special talents. Deep with the richest areas of the world (and only those areas) great temples to Amathaon provide rest and an endless bounty to those that would join them. They are less about worship and more about providing hospitality, like the world's best bed and breakfast. Often called the Lord of Plenty.
chinese: 阿玛桑似乎随机赐予他的恩赐，并不偏袒他的信徒胜过他人，但那些最虔敬丰饶之主的人已组织起来，为他所赐予特殊才华的人提供各种支持。在世界最富饶的地区深处（且仅在这些地区），敬奉阿玛桑的宏伟神庙为愿加入他们的人提供休憩与无尽的馈赠。它们与其说重在敬拜，不如说重在提供款待，如同世上最好的家庭旅馆。他常被称为丰饶之主。

english: Makhai
chinese: 马卡伊

english: In the Age of Ruin, when mankind is broken, the orc clans regroup and expand. The Clan of Embers reforms around the worship of an ifrit, who grants those willing to sacrifice themselves in battle great power. An orc shaman named Horkos controls a disease infected horde called The Eaters of the Dead. Most of the Orcs however fall under the sway of the Cult of the Blood God, following Makhai, an Ogre who is an Aspect of War.
chinese: 在毁灭时代，当人类支离破碎时，兽人氏族重新集结、壮大。余灰部落围绕对一个伊夫利特的敬奉而重组，那伊夫利特赋予甘愿在战斗中牺牲自己的人以巨大力量。一个名叫霍尔科斯的兽人萨满统领着一支染病的部众，名为食尸者。然而大多数兽人臣服于血神教，追随马卡伊——一个身为战争化身的食人巨魔。

english: Horkos
chinese: 霍尔科斯

chinese: 影子议会战争决议

english: Juror
chinese: 陪审员

chinese: 庭吏

english: Salamander
chinese: 火蜥蜴

english: Salamanders are made for war. Most were crusaders in life, spending their days on blood-soaked battlefields in allegiance to some ideal or command. Now the illusions of their ideals have been stripped from them and war is all that they seek. Salamanders differ from Camulos's demons in that they seek war for the ability to inflict pain and the sheer chaos. Salamanders love war for the conflict, for the struggle, for the clash of ideologies (even if they don't care which ideology wins). Leaders of rebellions are fond of summoning salamanders to aid them.
chinese: 火蜥蜴为战争而生。他们中大多数生前是十字军，为某种理想或号令效忠，在浸血的战场上度过时日。如今他们理想的幻象已被剥除，战争成了他们唯一的追求。火蜥蜴与卡姆罗斯的恶魔不同，他们寻求战争是为了施加痛苦的能力与纯粹的混乱。火蜥蜴热爱战争，是为了那冲突、那挣扎、那意识形态的碰撞（尽管他们并不在意哪种意识形态获胜）。叛乱的领袖们喜欢召唤火蜥蜴来助阵。

english: Silkie
chinese: 海豹精

english: These spirits appear as beautiful women in white gowns. Arawn has denied them access to the Otherworld. Now they wander creation. They tend to appear to heroes that are close to death, though they rarely interfere. They hope that somehow they can pass with that hero into death. Seeing a Silkie is generally a bad omen. [PARAGRAPH]Some Silkies morn having never had children and will occasionally "adopt" a baby. They appear to the child as he grows, less so as he gets older and can help protect the child. Silkies are in Arawn's dominion, they are not undead, because their spirits are bound to creation by Arawn's curse, not a perversion of death magic.
chinese: 这些灵体现身时是身着白袍的美丽女子。阿拉温拒绝她们进入异界。如今她们游荡于创世之间。她们往往现身于濒死的英雄面前，尽管她们鲜少干预。她们希望自己能以某种方式随那位英雄一同步入死亡。见到海豹精通常是个凶兆。[PARAGRAPH]有些海豹精为从未生育而哀伤，偶尔会“收养”一个婴儿。她们在孩子成长时现身，随着孩子渐长则渐少现身，并能帮助保护那孩子。海豹精属于阿拉温的领域，她们并非亡灵，因为她们的灵魂是被阿拉温的诅咒、而非死亡魔法的反常之术束缚于创世的。

english: Silkies are naturally immortal units that will abandon you if you leave the Eternal Cabal state religion
chinese: 海豹精是天生不朽的单位，若你脱离永恒秘党国教，她们便会舍弃你

english: Maoliosa the Barren
chinese: 不育者玛奥利莎

english: Maoliosa formed the Elohim cult called "The Betrothed" who killed themselves in a ceremony to become the brides of Arawn. Maoliosa is a particularly evil woman who never believed that any of the other woman would become the brides of Arawn, but that they would be her gift to Arawn that would cause him to fall in love with her. Arawn was so offended by the gesture that he didn't allow any of the women to enter the Otherworld and now they wander creation as Silkies. The curse, and the centuries has made Maoliosa crueler and now she (usually accompanied by many Silkies) wanders creation attempting to cause as much death as possible in the mistaken belief that it will somehow curry Arawn's favor. [PARAGRAPH]In the Age of Invention Maoliosa submits to Auric Ulvin and she and her Silkies become the concubines of death (despite the protests of Laroth).
chinese: 玛奥利莎组建了一个名为“已聘者”的埃洛希姆教派，她们在一场仪式中自尽，以成为阿拉温的新娘。玛奥利莎是个格外邪恶的女人，她从不相信其他女子中有任何人会成为阿拉温的新娘，而是相信她们将是她献给阿拉温的礼物，会令他爱上她。阿拉温被这一举动大为冒犯，以至于他不允许任何一名女子进入异界，如今她们作为海豹精游荡于创世。这诅咒与数百年的岁月使玛奥利莎愈发残忍，如今她（通常有许多海豹精相伴）游荡于创世，试图制造尽可能多的死亡，误以为这会以某种方式讨得阿拉温的欢心。[PARAGRAPH]在创新时代，玛奥利莎臣服于奥里克·尤尔文，她与她的海豹精成为死亡的姬妾（尽管拉洛斯对此表示反对）。

english: Neasa
chinese: 尼萨

english: Neasa was the youngest member (just over 12 years old) of "the Betrothed", a cult that killed themselves in an elaborate wedding ceremony to become the brides of Arawn. Arawn was so offended by the act that he didn't let any of them enter the Otherworld and they wander creation as Silkies instead. Neasa is the most friendly of the silkies, and will occasionally appear to those in need as a ghostly young girl in a white gown. She is likely to help those that are trying to avenge a murder. [PARAGRAPH]During the Age of Invention Neasa doesn't follow the rest of the Silkies to serve Auric, but stays in the Elohim city of Niveus instead, and is occasionally seen around the temple of the Matronae.
chinese: 尼萨是“已聘者”中最年幼的成员（刚满 12 岁），那是一个在精心筹备的婚礼仪式中自尽、以成为阿拉温新娘的教派。阿拉温被此举大为冒犯，以至于他不让她们中任何人进入异界，她们只得作为海豹精游荡于创世。尼萨是海豹精中最友善的一位，偶尔会以一个身着白袍的幽灵少女形象，现身于有难之人面前。她很可能会帮助那些试图为一桩谋杀复仇的人。[PARAGRAPH]在创新时代，尼萨没有随其余海豹精去为奥里克效力，而是留在了埃洛希姆城市尼维乌斯，偶尔会在母神会神庙附近被人看见。

english: Merry Dancer
chinese: 欢乐舞者

english: A Merry Dancer is a demon who has been saved by the compassion of Sirona. They have repented and forsaken all forms of violence and hatred and are now creatures of joy, beauty and peace. [PARAGRAPH]As angels of Sirona they continue to minister to those damned to hell, offering them the same forgiveness that allows them to repent become Merry Dancers themselves. [PARAGRAPH]Sallos was a soldier from a small and dismal duchy at the edge of the Patrian Empire. He grew tired of what he thought was a meaningless life. When he captured a Merry Dancer he sacrificed the creature in the hope that something will hear his call. His call was heard and Hyborem answered and offered him seven years of power in exchange for his eternal servitude and that of his descendants.
chinese: 欢乐舞者是一个被希柔娜的恻隐之心所拯救的恶魔。他们已然忏悔，摒弃了一切形式的暴力与仇恨，如今成了欢乐、美与和平的造物。[PARAGRAPH]作为希柔娜的天使，他们继续向那些被打入地狱者布道，向他们提供同样的宽恕，让他们得以忏悔、自己也成为欢乐舞者。[PARAGRAPH]萨洛斯是帕特里亚帝国边陲一个既小又阴郁的公国的士兵。他厌倦了他自认为毫无意义的人生。当他俘获一名欢乐舞者时，他献祭了这生物，希望有什么会听见他的呼唤。他的呼唤被听见了，海勃雷姆应了他，提出以七年的力量，换取他与其后裔永世的奴役。

english: Merry Dancers are purely defensive and not particularly strong when it comes to combat, but they may the be best troops to use against the Infernal. Their special ability allows you convert your rival's demonic units into more Merry Dancers serving you.
chinese: 欢乐舞者纯粹是防御性的，就战斗而言并不特别强，但他们或许是对付地狱军团的最佳部队。他们的特殊能力让你能将对手的恶魔单位转化为更多为你效力的欢乐舞者。

english: Mithril is prized in part for its ability to resist spells of all kinds, leading to highly sought after armor for any warrior. However, even the Luchuirp Arch-Enchanters found themselves unable to bind any enchantments, no matter what form it was given. For a long time the idea was thought to be impossible. Then one day a dwarven city was overrun by a legion of drowned. The Artificer who found the ruins cried out to Nantosuelta, rending his clothes as he fell to his knees in horror. Every dwarven woman and child had been beheaded, the men dragged towards the waters, presumably to rise again and spread the misery further through the land. Nantosuelta's heart broke, and she spoke to the Artificer, instructing him to build the largest golem ever seen, shaped like a dwarf but cast of pure Mithril. When the time golem was finished, he was told, Nantosuelta would give it life as their spells could not. What they would do with it was up to them; the goddess knew she was intervening too much already. The Tinker nodded, and gathered his hammer and set off for the Holy city. It would take a long time to forge the parts, and much blood would be shed as he toiled stoically day after day. But the evil would be pushed from the land-forever.
chinese: 秘银之所以珍贵，部分在于它抵抗一切魔法的能力，这令任何战士都对其铠甲趋之若鹜。然而，即便是鲁崔尔普的大附魔师们，也发现自己无论将它铸成何种形态，都无法束缚任何附魔。长久以来，这一构想都被认为不可能实现。直到有一天，一座矮人城市被一支溺死大军攻陷。发现那废墟的巧匠向南托苏埃尔妲哭喊，恐惧地跪倒在地，撕扯着自己的衣裳。每一个矮人女子与孩童都被斩首，男子则被拖向水中，想必是要再度复起、将苦难散布得更广。南托苏埃尔妲心碎了，她对那巧匠开口，指示他建造一座前所未见的巨大魔像，塑成矮人的模样，却以纯秘银铸成。她告诉他，待那魔像完工，南托苏埃尔妲便会赋予它他们的法术所不能赋予的生命。至于他们要拿它做什么，则由他们自己决定；女神知道自己已然干预太多。这修补匠点了点头，取起他的锤子，动身前往圣城。锻造这些部件将耗时良久，他日复一日地默然劳作，其间也将有许多鲜血流淌。但那邪恶终将被逐出这片土地——永远地。

english: Formed of mithril and infused with the power of Nantosuelta herself, the Mithril Golem is an avatar unit and one of the most powerful units in the game.
chinese: 秘银魔像以秘银铸成，注入了南托苏埃尔妲本尊的力量，是一个化身单位，也是游戏中最强大的单位之一。

english: Khalida the Suicidal
chinese: 自戕者哈莉达

english: Khalida is suicidal. She often kills herself, but her power brings her back, alive and full of even stronger death magic. She pays a horrible price for her power, but does it when she has no other option.
chinese: 哈莉达寻死。她常常自尽，但她的力量将她带回，活生生的，且怀着更为强大的死亡魔法。她为自己的力量付出可怖的代价，但只在别无选择时才如此。

english: Khalida's strength wanes each turn that she does not die, or whenever she kills another, but whenever she does die she is reborn with strength increased based on youri effective supply of Death mana
chinese: 哈莉达的力量在她不死的每一回合、或每当她杀死他人时都会衰减，但每当她确实死去时，她便重生，其力量根据你有效的死亡魔力供应而提升

english: Redeemer
chinese: 救世者

english: The High Priests of Sirona offer mercy and forgiveness to even the most vile demons, offering them a chance to be redeemed as ascend to become angels of mercy themselves.
chinese: 希柔娜的主教对即便是最卑劣的恶魔也施以慈悲与宽恕，给予他们被救赎、进而升华为慈悲天使的机会。

english: Crony
chinese: 亲信

english: Cronies can spread the corruption of their own greed to others, turning otherwise valiant patriots and idealists into mere mercenaries who will abandon their posts if not paid well and may easily be bribed into betraying their friends and families.
chinese: 亲信能将他们自身贪欲的腐败散布于他人，将本该英勇的爱国者与理想主义者变作纯粹的雇佣兵——若不给足报酬便会弃守其岗位，且极易被收买去背叛其亲友。

english: The Druids were priests of Sucellus since the Age of Dragons, when he lived among the Elves and presided over the dominion of Nature. They continue to honor him now that he has risen as the God of Life, but some of the Unblemished hold that most Druids are still too tainted by the dogmas of his original sphere to serve him properly in this age. Some Druids, however, have manifested such a pure faith that none can doubt their devotion to Life. These have followed their god's example and sacrificed their lives for a greater cause, and been reborn in his new image. The Reborn are the greatest healers in Erebus, often able to raise the long dead and almost always able to resurrect themselves indefinitely.
chinese: 自龙之时代起，德鲁伊便是苏塞鲁斯的祭司——彼时他生活在精灵之中，主掌自然领域。如今他既已作为生命之神崛起，他们仍继续敬奉他，但纯洁之众中有些人认为，大多数德鲁伊仍被他原初领域的教条玷污太深，无法在这个时代恰当地为他效力。然而，有些德鲁伊显现出如此纯粹的信仰，以至于无人能质疑他们对生命的虔敬。这些人效法他们神祇的榜样，为更崇高的事业牺牲了性命，并以他的新形象重生。重生者是埃瑞玻斯最伟大的医者，往往能唤起久亡之人，且几乎总能无限次地复活自己。

english: The Unblemished High Priests are Druids blessed with powers of healing so great that they can repeatedly raise themselves from the dead
chinese: 纯洁之众的主教是被赐予治愈之力的德鲁伊，其力量之巨，以至于他们能反复地起死回生

english: Genius
chinese: 天才

english: Amathaon does not have a hierarchy of priests and high priests. He does not bless his worshipers with miracles, but grants great talents to many individuals apparently at random. Those who worship Amathaon are no more likely to be gifted with such talents, but they work hard to help others develop their gifts. A Curator is focused on help Great Persons develop their full potential, although their is some chance that enough experience around the highly talented may help one become a Genius in his own right.
chinese: 阿玛桑没有祭司与主教的等级体系。他不以奇迹赐福他的信徒，而是看似随机地将卓越天赋赋予众多个体。敬奉阿玛桑的人被赐予此类天赋的几率并不更高，但他们努力帮助他人发展自己的天赋。馆长专注于帮助伟人充分发挥其潜能，尽管在极具天赋者周围积累足够的历练，也有一定几率使人自身成为天才。

english: The Genius is the closest equivalent to a High Priest found among the House of Plenty, but unlike other high priests they are not upgraded from normal priests at level 6. Curators cannot become Geniuses, but any Great Person (that does not follow a different faith) may upgrade to a Genius and gain superior versions of the abilities of all the great person types.
chinese: 天才是丰饶之家中最接近主教的存在，但与其他主教不同，他们并非在 6 级时由普通祭司升级而来。馆长无法成为天才，但任何伟人（只要不信奉别的信仰）皆可升级为天才，获得所有伟人类型能力的更优版本。

english: [ICON_BULLET]The Sheaim get Emyrs instead of Chainbreakers. Instead of focusing on their opposition to slavery, these fanatics specialize in seducing those with arcane talent promises of access to secret knowledge that mage guilds outside of Sheaim control consider too dangerous to teach. They target arcane units in combat and have a chance to capture any adepts or mages they defeat, plus a special ability to [LINK=SPELL_SEDUCE_SORCERER]Seduce Sorcerers[\\LINK] without combat.
chinese: [ICON_BULLET]塞安得到的是埃姆里斯，而非断链者。这些狂热者不再专注于反对奴隶制，而是专精于以获取秘密知识的许诺来引诱那些拥有秘法天赋者——那些知识被塞安掌控之外的法师公会视为过于危险而不予传授。他们在战斗中以秘法单位为目标，有几率俘获任何被他们击败的术士或魔法师，外加一项无需战斗即可 [LINK=SPELL_SEDUCE_SORCERER]引诱术士[\\LINK] 的特殊能力。

chinese: 迪布克

english: The Dybbuk are malicious spirits that can control the soul of someone who recently died. They have little power over the just, though those burdened with sin are easy prey for them. The Dybbuk can force the soul to possess a living or dead host. [PARAGRAPH]Ghoul- When a Dybbuk leaves a corrupted soul in the body of a dead host it becomes a ghoul. [PARAGRAPH]Wight- When a Dybbuk leaves a corrupted soul in the body of a dead host and the Dybbuk remains to strengthen and control the soul then the creature is known as a Wight. Wights are more powerful than ghouls and their touch steals the life and strength of their victim. Although Dybbuk prefer to not draw too much attention to themselves when threatened they can usually raise a group of ghouls lead by a Wight to defend themselves
chinese: 迪布克是恶毒的灵体，能控制新近死者的灵魂。他们对正直者几无力量，但那些背负罪孽的人则易成他们的猎物。迪布克能迫使灵魂附身于生者或死者宿主。[PARAGRAPH]食尸鬼——当迪布克将一个被腐化的灵魂留在死者宿主的躯体中时，它便成为食尸鬼。[PARAGRAPH]尸妖——当迪布克将一个被腐化的灵魂留在死者宿主的躯体中，且迪布克留下来强化并控制该灵魂时，这生物便被称为尸妖。尸妖比食尸鬼更强大，其触碰会窃取受害者的生命与力量。尽管迪布克在受威胁时宁愿不太引人注目，他们通常能召起一群由尸妖统领的食尸鬼来自卫

english: A Dybbuk with access to Sluaghs (whose alignments are not Good) can use them possess and take control of living units or undead units. The undead units gain all the promotions from the Sluagh. The Sluagh is used up in the process, preventing future resurrections
chinese: 一个能取用鬼灵（其阵营非善）的迪布克，可用它们附身并控制生者单位或亡灵单位。亡灵单位会获得鬼灵的全部晋升。鬼灵在此过程中被耗尽，阻止将来的复活

english: Use your priests to speed healing, build a temple, to cure diseases, or to use their divine spells. With promotions they can also remove unwanted religions from cities, spread their religion without sacrificing themselves, or get a chance to convert defeated foes. There is no limit to how many priests of your state religion you may train, but those of other religions are treated like national units with a limit of 7 and their spells are likely to be miscast.
chinese: 用你的祭司加速治愈、建造神庙、治愈疾病，或使用他们的神圣法术。凭借晋升，他们还能从城市移除不受欢迎的宗教、无需牺牲自己即可传播其宗教，或获得转化被击败之敌的机会。你可训练的国教祭司数量没有上限，但其他宗教的祭司则被视作国家单位，上限为 7，且他们的法术很可能会施法失误。

english: The Order demands unquestioning obedience. The Undertow, a lifetime of slavery. The Veil takes your soul. See how much more merciful I am?
chinese: 绝对秩序要求无条件的服从。深渊，要一辈子的奴役。灰烬夺走你的灵魂。看看我要仁慈得多？

english: Your confessor approaches you as you prepare your army to move. "Commander Decius, we have uncovered the source of the taint we discovered in the jungles. In fact, it stems from the ports of the Lanun. We had negotiated trade relations with the Lanun, but apparently they have allowed their cities to be infested by the Undertow. We must wipe out every city with the Undertow religion."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Rosier says "So you only freed the twisted men in order to track them down and destroy them?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"If these people have given their souls to demons, their lives are forfeit. If their Oaths hold true, they shall dwell with Junil forever. Either way we shall protect the Bannor from this taint, and the power of the good shall not fade nor flicker from the face of Erebus."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"This seems less of good than of power to me, Decius." says Rosier.
chinese: 当你准备调动军队时，你的忏悔祭司走近你。“德西乌斯指挥官，我们已查明我们在丛林中发现的那股污秽的源头。事实上，它源自拉努恩的港口。我们曾与拉努恩谈妥了贸易往来，但他们显然已任由自己的城市被深渊霸主感染。我们必须荡平每一座信奉深渊霸主的城市。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]罗希尔说：“这么说，你解放那些扭曲之人，只是为了追踪并摧毁他们？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“若这些人已把灵魂交给了恶魔，他们的性命便已注定。若他们的誓约当真，他们将永世与朱尼尔同在。无论如何，我们都将保护班诺尔免于这股污秽，善之力量绝不会从埃瑞玻斯的大地上消退或闪灭。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“在我看来，德西乌斯，这与其说是善，不如说是力量。”罗希尔说。

english: A Speaker is brought before you as you watch the destruction of the Lanun's Temple of the Undertow. "Your trespass here is unforgivable! This sacred ground rings with echoes of the depths."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Your allegiance to evil has sealed your fate," Wallon says.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Fate is ours to twist, and vengeance mine to take. Rise, servants!"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Decius scans the horizon, then shouts to his advisors, "Look to the horizon! Drown rise from the depths and head for Cuantine. We cannot get there before them on foot."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Rosier says "The artifacts of these cultists, I have seen them used to travel over the water."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"We cannot risk the taint these bear," the Confessor tells him.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Foolish priest, it is worth the risk. You gamble the lives of our people for your purity's sake? You follow your law, then, and I will follow my own heart." Rosier dons the mask of the Speaker, and heads towards the waves.
chinese: 当你注视着拉努恩深渊霸主神庙的毁灭时，一名代言者被带到你面前。“你在此地的擅闯不可饶恕！这片圣地回荡着深渊的回响。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“你对邪恶的效忠已注定你的命运。”沃隆说。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“命运任我们扭曲，复仇由我来取。起来吧，仆从们！”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]德西乌斯扫视着地平线，随即向他的顾问们高呼：“看那地平线！溺死者正从深渊崛起，朝库安汀而去。我们徒步无法赶在他们之前抵达。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]罗希尔说：“这些狂热者的法器，我曾见它们被用来渡水而行。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“我们不能冒这些东西所带污秽的险。”忏悔祭司告诉他。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“愚蠢的祭司，这险值得一冒。你为了自己的纯洁，竟拿我们子民的性命去赌？那你便遵你的律法，我则遵从我自己的内心。”罗希尔戴上代言者的面具，朝波涛走去。

english: Falamar.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]There was nothing but darkness.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Falamar."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]I twisted in my dreams. I still imagined the tentacle around my leg through the veil of fear and emptiness. I drifted toward eternal sleep, but something wouldn't let me go.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Falamar."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]I opened my eyes and there was water all around, a world without earth or sky. I floated weightless in the current, forever falling in the seas caress.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]There was another above me, a woman, but as inhuman as she was beautiful. She was the tide, powerful but yielding, fleeting but eternal.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Who are you?" I asked.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"I am Condatis, the archangel of Danalin, God of the Sea."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Afraid, I tried to swim away from her. I wasn't religious but I had seen enough temples and asylums of those that worshiped Danalin to suspect that this wasn't the afterlife I intended. Even if it did feature floating billowy maidens.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Danalin? As in the Undertow? Is this the heaven for Cultists and Dreamers?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]She looked hurt. There was pain in her eyes, and love. I regretted my words.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"No." she replied.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Oh... are you my reward?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"No!" she said, this time there was anger in her eyes.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]I seemed to be getting this all wrong so I just floated silently and let her speak.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"I led you to Keelyn so that she would take you to her father, but Hastur predicts my actions. An archmage, Tebryn Arbandi, means to destroy creation. Go to the Momus, convince him to supply you with a fleet then sail through the Arduro Straight to the Dead Lands. Defeat Tebryn so I have time to defeat Hastur."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"You sure you don't want Capria, or that guy that killed Mulcarn? I'm more of a steal-the-king's-galleon kind of hero."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]She smiled, "My young prince, we must all make do with what we have."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The water rippled and her face was replaced with the bearded face of Amergin. He was pulling me up on the beach.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Falamar, are you okay?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"I'm okay," I stammered through racking coughs, "how are the men?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Some are fine, others haven't been recovered yet."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]I understood his meaning and picked myself up. After recovering far too few of my men from the sea we went to meet with Perpentach. He ignored the threat of Tebryn and my pleas for help. But he was holding a competition between warlords, and he promised to supply the navy I required if I won. With few men and no ships, we had little choice but to enter.
chinese: 法拉玛。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]除了黑暗，一无所有。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“法拉玛。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]我在梦中扭动。透过恐惧与虚空的帷幕，我仍能想象出缠着我腿的那条触手。我漂向永恒的沉眠，但有什么不肯放我离去。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“法拉玛。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]我睁开双眼，四周尽是海水，一个没有大地或天空的世界。我在水流中失重地漂浮，永远地坠入海洋的爱抚。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]我上方还有另一位，一个女子，却如她之美一般不似凡人。她是潮汐，强大却柔顺，短暂却永恒。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“你是谁？”我问。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“我是康达提斯，海神达纳林的大天使。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]我惊惧，试图从她身边游开。我并不信教，但我见过足够多敬奉达纳林之人的神庙与疯人院，足以怀疑这不是我想要的那种来世。哪怕它确实有漂浮的丰腴少女。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“达纳林？就是那个深渊霸主？这是狂热者与做梦者的天堂吗？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]她看上去受了伤。她眼中有痛楚，也有爱意。我为自己的话感到后悔。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“不。”她答道。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“哦……你是我的奖赏吗？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“不是！”她说，这次她眼中有了怒意。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]我似乎全都理解错了，于是我只是静静漂浮，让她开口。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“我引你去琪琳身边，好让她带你去见她父亲，但哈斯图尔预料到了我的行动。一位大法师，特布里恩·阿尔班第，意欲毁灭创世。去见摩姆斯，说服他为你提供一支舰队，随后穿过阿尔杜罗海峡前往亡域。击败特布里恩，好让我有时间击败哈斯图尔。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“你确定不要凯布瑞尔，或者那个杀了穆卡恩的家伙？我更像是那种偷国王大帆船的英雄。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]她微笑道：“我年轻的王子，我们都得将就着用手头所有的。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]水面泛起涟漪，她的脸被阿默金那张蓄须的脸取代。他正把我拉上海滩。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“法拉玛，你没事吧？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“我没事，”我在剧烈的咳嗽间结结巴巴地说，“弟兄们怎么样了？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“有些没事，其余的还没找回来。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]我明白他的意思，撑起身子。从海里找回的弟兄少得可怜之后，我们前去会见普宾塔克。他无视了特布里恩的威胁与我求援的恳求。但他正在军阀之间举办一场竞赛，并许诺若我获胜，便为我提供我所需的海军。手下人少、又无船只，我们别无选择，只得参赛。

english: Dreamer
chinese: 做梦者

english: I have not been able to discern how the Cultists choose their Dreamers. Sometimes it is a vagrant, sometimes the son or daughter of a noble, and everyone in between seems eligible. He is abducted and taken to temple, usually on the night of the full moon. The hands and feet are bound. Sleep is induced. Some sects use various herbal concoctions; this one simply strangled the man until he passed out. He is laid in a shallow pool, submerged partially in sea water.[PARAGRAPH:1]All night the Cultists gather around, listening for anything he might say in this sleep. This becomes the Dreamer's new name. It is etched onto a clay jar, which is filled with sea water. I observed the names on some of these. "The Leviathan Trembles But Does Not Awaken," read one. "Pour the Blood of the Slaves Into the Styx," another. The victim tonight seemed to hear nothing, for he was silent as he slept, nearly until dawn. Should this be the case, the victim is drowned and serves in the undead army of the Undertow. Fortunately for this man, or perhaps not, he at last called out screaming, "The distant one has watching eyes!"[PARAGRAPH:1]The Cultists nodded to each other and pulled the man from the water. When he saw them holding him, he cringed. They spoke not to him, but dragged him to the back of the temple. I was unable to follow, but observed the Dreamer days later in sea colored robes. He had bloodshot eyes, and moved through the crowd in the town marketplace engaged in a constant dialogue with himself.[PARAGRAPH:2]From chapter 7 of Reflections on the State Cults, by Elder Methyl of the Luonnotar.
chinese: 我一直无从辨明狂热者是如何挑选他们的做梦者的。有时是个流浪汉，有时是贵族的儿女，而介乎其间的每一个人似乎都有资格。他被掳走，带往神庙，通常在满月之夜。手脚被缚。诱其入睡。有些教派使用各种草药调剂；这一个只是把那人勒到昏厥。他被安置在一处浅池中，半浸于海水里。[PARAGRAPH:1]整夜里，狂热者围聚一旁，倾听他在这睡梦中可能说出的任何话语。这将成为做梦者的新名字。它被刻在一只陶罐上，罐中盛满海水。我观察了其中几只罐上的名字。“利维坦颤动，却未苏醒”，一只上写道。“将奴隶之血倾入冥河”，另一只写道。今夜的受害者似乎什么也没听见，因为他在睡梦中默然无声，几乎直到破晓。若真如此，受害者便会被溺死，在深渊霸主的亡灵大军中效力。对这人来说算是幸运，或许也未必，他最终尖叫着喊了出来：“那遥远之物有窥视的眼睛！”[PARAGRAPH:1]狂热者们彼此点头，将那人从水中拉出。当他看见他们抓着自己时，他畏缩了。他们并未对他开口，而是将他拖往神庙后方。我无从跟随，但数日后观察到那做梦者身着海色长袍。他双眼布满血丝，在镇上集市的人群中穿行，不断地自言自语。[PARAGRAPH:2]摘自天母审判官长老美西尔所著《国教沉思录》第七章。

english: Kraken are a rare but terrifying sight for any sailor, and a potent weapon when commanded by an Undertow priest. Even in death, their bodies contain potent magics and can be used in a variety of minor spells. The massive eyes are especially useful, able to be enchanted to give a priest vision of a large area nearby.
chinese: 大海妖对任何水手而言都是罕见却令人惊骇的景象，而在深渊霸主祭司的驱使下则是一件强力武器。即便死后，它们的躯体仍蕴含强大的魔法，可用于各种小型法术。那巨大的眼睛尤为有用，可被附魔以赋予祭司窥视附近大片区域的视野。

english: The galley was the first ship designed for war. Galleys were powered by banks of oars on each side, manned by well-trained oarsmen. These oarsmen were highly paid professionals or patriotic citizens (except in Undertow countries). A huge, bronze "beak" mounted at the bow of the ship was used to ram and sink enemy ships. Because of its long, narrow hull, the galley was very unstable in all but the calmest waters, and as a consequence its crew rarely ventured out of sight of land for long periods of time, lest the ship be caught in a storm and sunk.
chinese: 桨帆船是最早为战争而设计的船只。桨帆船由两舷成排的桨提供动力，由训练有素的桨手操作。这些桨手是高薪的职业人士或爱国的公民（深渊霸主国家除外）。船首装有一具巨大的青铜“喙”，用以撞击并击沉敌船。由于其狭长的船身，桨帆船在除最平静水域外的一切水域中都极不稳定，因此其船员鲜少长时间远离陆地视线，以免船只被风暴困住而沉没。

english: They called him an affective dreamer. It was a horrible attunement with magic that few were cursed with; what he dreamed became real.[PARAGRAPH:1]When he was 12, Hemah saw salamanders playing on the wet stones. They were like living pieces of painted mercury, tiny dragons who had an entire primordial world underneath the dock behind his home. They hissed at Hemah, as if confidence alone would keep him from squashing them.[PARAGRAPH:1]That night the hisses came again, but lower, echoing through the small stone house. Slick painted demons broke through the walls. With forked tongues, they scuttled through the shadows and grabbed Hemah's parents, dragging them from the house.[PARAGRAPH:1]He slept through it all. In the morning, the neighbors' screams woke him. Most of the house had collapsed, only his room remained standing. The neighbor's wife was a round woman with a voice so high she seemed to squeal like the pigs she and her husband raised. She rushed in and threw herself on Hemah, checking to make sure he was okay. They told him to close his eyes before they led him out of his room, but he looked.[PARAGRAPH:1]Claw marks, blood, everything was broken...and his parents were missing. They searched everywhere for them, but couldn't find them, but Hemah knew where they were. He led the pig farmer and his wife to the river behind their home and looked beneath the dock. That's where they found Hemah's parents' broken bodies, their mouths stuffed with so much mud their throats had exploded.[PARAGRAPH:1]Since then, everyone who has gotten close to Hemah has died, not that those who don't know him do much better. One morning, he awoke to find the entire population of the small village he was passing through was simply gone. Sometimes creatures are created that live well after he awakes. People are killed, women are raped. Men are made into puppets for the night, forced to play out scenes from Hemah's subconscious over and over again.[PARAGRAPH:1]Some say Hemah isn't a mage, he only dreamt he was once and he hasn't forgotten the dream. Others wonder if the Undertow found Hemah and caused his dreams, or if Hemah dreamt of the Undertow and created them. What is known is that as dangerous as Hemah is awake, he is even more dangerous asleep.
chinese: 他们称他为感应做梦者。那是一种可怖的魔法调谐，鲜有人受此诅咒；他所梦见的，都会成真。[PARAGRAPH:1]赫玛 12 岁时，看见火蜥蜴在湿漉漉的石头上嬉戏。它们宛如活生生的彩绘水银块，是些微小的龙，在他家后头的码头下拥有一整个原始世界。它们朝赫玛嘶嘶作响，仿佛单凭气势就能让他不去踩扁它们。[PARAGRAPH:1]那夜，嘶嘶声再度传来，却更低沉，在这座小小的石屋中回荡。油滑的彩绘恶魔破墙而入。它们吐着分叉的舌头，窜过阴影，抓住赫玛的父母，将他们拖出屋去。[PARAGRAPH:1]他自始至终睡着。清晨，邻居的尖叫将他惊醒。屋子大半已坍塌，唯有他的房间仍矗立着。邻居的妻子是个圆胖的女人，嗓音尖得像她和丈夫养的猪一样嚎叫。她冲进来，扑到赫玛身上，查看他是否安好。他们让他闭上眼睛，才领他走出房间，但他还是看了。[PARAGRAPH:1]爪痕、鲜血，一切都被砸碎……而他的父母不见了。他们四处搜寻，却找不到他们，但赫玛知道他们在哪里。他领着养猪的农夫与他妻子来到他们家后头的河边，朝码头下望去。他们就是在那里找到了赫玛父母残破的躯体，他们的嘴里被塞满了泥，多得胀破了喉咙。[PARAGRAPH:1]从那以后，凡是接近赫玛的人都死了，不过那些不认识他的人也好不到哪里去。一天清晨，他醒来发现自己途经的那座小村庄全体村民干脆凭空消失了。有时会有一些生物被造出来，在他醒来后仍长久存活。人被杀死，女子被强暴。男人被变作供他夜间摆布的傀儡，被迫一遍又一遍演出赫玛潜意识中的场景。[PARAGRAPH:1]有人说赫玛并非法师，他只是曾梦见自己是，而他至今未从那梦中醒来。也有人琢磨，是深渊霸主找到了赫玛并造成了他的梦，还是赫玛梦见了深渊霸主并将他们创造出来。可以确知的是，赫玛醒时有多危险，睡时便更加危险。

english: Hemah is an excellent spell caster available to Undertow followers only. His Channeling I-IV promotions and two affinities (Water and Mind) make him one of the greatest caster's in the game
chinese: 赫玛是唯有深渊霸主信徒才能获得的出色施法者。他的引导 I-IV 晋升与两种亲和（水与心智）使他成为游戏中最伟大的施法者之一

english: The old captain reluctantly rose from his seat at the cabin, where he had been perusing his collection of maps. They had arrived, one of the crew had told him in a rather shaken voice. He was not at all comfortable with the situation, but he knew that he must not show it, or even think of it. They could sense that kind of thing, he had heard, and while not superstitious, he nevertheless was a careful man, the evidence of which being the fact that he had managed to become so old despite his dangerous profession.[PARAGRAPH:1]As he came up on deck, he noticed that the afternoon sun had given way to foggy twilight. He must have been in the cabin for longer than he thought, though a small voice in the back of his mind told him that it was because of their presence. He resolved to ignore the voice, but he feared it was going to become more insistent soon. He'd better get these negotiations over with quickly, hopefully he would receive the reward without trouble, and be able to head home to Selena as soon as possible. The small voice laughed at this thought, but it was a bitter and humorless laughter tinged with desperation.[PARAGRAPH:1]He saw their ship anchored next to theirs, he saw the plank that had provided a makeshift bridge, and finally his eyes fell upon the dark silhouette standing on the deck before him, with a few smaller ones scattered behind.[PARAGRAPH:1]"Good evening, captain. It is truly a nice ship you've got here."[PARAGRAPH:1]The voice was warm and friendly in a slightly disturbing sort of way, a little bit like the warm and friendly voice of a predator luring its prey, the small voice commented. The figure made a gesture with what the captain fervently hoped was its arm, apparently meant simply to indicate the ship, but somehow managing to appear much more ominous. By the Undertow, this was unsettling! Then, a bit too late to be proper etiquette, he realized that he was expected to say something.[PARAGRAPH:1]"Y-yes, thank you. Reputedly the best ship in the fleet, we are...."[PARAGRAPH:1]"Of course you are. We chose you for the mission. Because your ship was chosen by Us, it follows logically that it is the best. We do not make mistakes. Thus it is and thus it always will be. Tell us of your mission."[PARAGRAPH:1]The captain was momentarily baffled at the way the tone of voice so quickly changed from alluring to commanding, but he could do nothing but obey. In a voice more stuttering in actuality than the captain believed it to be, he recounted the story of the past week. Of how they had sailed with the rest of the fleet to lead the final attack. Of how the fleet had sailed through hidden canals and shallow rivers to take the city by surprise. Of how the captain and his crew had, the night before the fleet reached the city, stealthily left the fleet to sail ahead and warn the city of the attack, betraying the positions of the other ships. Of how soldiers from the city had rushed to the ships' position under cover of darkness, destroying them and massacring their unprepared crews with ease.[PARAGRAPH:1]As the tale progressed, the captain felt increasingly uncomfortable, and it must have been evident on his face, because the dark figure replied:[PARAGRAPH:1]"Do not trouble yourself with meaningless guilt, captain. When We first approached you, We offered you a choice between death and life. You chose life. Life at the expense of many deaths, deaths of friends and allies perhaps, but life nonetheless. It was the rational choice. It is the choice We would have made. Given the circumstances, yes, it was the right choice. You couldn't have known, after all..."[PARAGRAPH:1]The captain at first felt comforted by this, but then he suddenly heard the last sentence again in his mind, and a great feeling of horror overcame him.[PARAGRAPH:1]"No...no...please...no..."he moaned[PARAGRAPH:1]"You did not know that the choice We offered to you was not in fact a choice between life and death, but rather a choice between loyalty and betrayal. What We knew and you did not was that death would follow in either case. As We previously said, We do not make mistakes. Letting you live would be a mistake."[PARAGRAPH:1]"No...NO! You promised...you promised...what have I done...?" The captain was sobbing now. [PARAGRAPH:1]"An amusing comment. A betrayer should know better than to hold others to their word, We find."[PARAGRAPH:1]The dark figure took a staff that had been hanging on its back, and proceeded to ram it straight downwards into the ship, ignoring the sobbing captain. A flash of darkish purple light shone, and when the captain looked up again through his tear-filled eyes, They had vanished, along with their ship, leaving an enormous hole straight through the vessel, which was quickly starting to take in water. As the rest of the crew rushed about on the ship, panicking and making feeble attempts at saving themselves, the captain merely sat on his knees in front of the crack, thinking of the lives he had destroyed, thinking of Selena, thinking of his folly, all the while longing for the waves that would end his suffering.[PARAGRAPH:1]As They knew then, and he did not, the suffering of him and his crew was not, in fact, about to end. It was about to begin.
chinese: 老船长不情愿地从舱室座位上起身，方才他一直在那里翻阅他收藏的地图。他们到了，一名船员用相当发颤的嗓音告诉过他。他对这处境全然不自在，但他知道自己绝不能表露出来，甚至连想都不能想。他听说过，那种东西能感知到这类情绪，而他虽不迷信，却依然是个谨慎之人——他明明从事着如此危险的行当却得以活到这般年纪，便是明证。[PARAGRAPH:1]当他来到甲板上，他注意到午后的阳光已让位于雾蒙蒙的暮色。他在舱室里待的时间必是比他以为的要久，尽管脑海深处一个细小的声音告诉他，那是因为它们的存在。他决意无视那声音，但他担心它不久便会变得更加执拗。他最好尽快了结这场谈判，但愿他能顺利拿到报酬，尽快启程回到塞蕾娜身边。那细小的声音嘲笑着这一念头，但那是一种苦涩、毫无笑意、带着绝望的嗤笑。[PARAGRAPH:1]他看见他们的船锚泊在自己的船旁，看见那块权充临时桥梁的跳板，最后他的目光落在了立于他面前甲板上的那道黑暗剪影上，身后还零星散布着几个较小的身影。[PARAGRAPH:1]“晚上好，船长。你这船真是艘好船。”[PARAGRAPH:1]那嗓音温暖而友善，带着一丝令人不安的意味，有点像捕食者引诱猎物时那温暖而友善的嗓音，那细小的声音评论道。那身影用一样东西——船长热切地希望那是它的手臂——做了个手势，看似只是要指一指这船，却不知怎的显得凶险得多。以深渊霸主之名，这太令人不安了！随后，稍稍晚了点、有失礼数地，他意识到自己该说点什么了。[PARAGRAPH:1]“是——是的，多谢。据说是这支舰队里最好的船，我们……”[PARAGRAPH:1]“那是自然。我们选中了你去执行这任务。既然你的船是被我们选中的，那么合乎逻辑地，它便是最好的。我们不犯错。事已如此，将来亦复如是。把你的任务讲给我们听。”[PARAGRAPH:1]那语气如此迅速地从诱人转为命令，船长一时错愕，但他除了服从别无他法。他用一种实际上比他自以为的更结巴的嗓音，讲述了过去一周的经过。讲他们如何随其余舰队起航去率领最后的进攻。讲舰队如何穿过隐蔽的水道与浅河，出其不意地攻取那座城市。讲船长与其船员如何在舰队抵达该城的前一夜，悄然离队抢先航行去警告那座城市这场进攻，出卖了其他船只的位置。讲那座城市的士兵如何在夜色掩护下奔向这些船只的位置，轻而易举地将它们摧毁、将其猝不及防的船员屠戮殆尽。[PARAGRAPH:1]随着故事推进，船长感到愈发不安，这必是显露在了他脸上，因为那黑暗身影答道：[PARAGRAPH:1]“别拿毫无意义的愧疚来折磨自己，船长。当我们初次找上你时，我们给了你死与生之间的一个选择。你选择了生。以许多人的死为代价的生，或许是朋友与盟友的死，但终究是生。那是理性的选择。是我们也会做的选择。就当时的情形而言，是的，那是正确的选择。毕竟，你当时无从知晓……”[PARAGRAPH:1]船长起初为此感到宽慰，但随即他脑中忽然又响起那最后一句话，一股巨大的恐惧攫住了他。[PARAGRAPH:1]“不……不……求你……不……”他呻吟着[PARAGRAPH:1]“你并不知道，我们给你的那个选择，其实并非生与死之间的选择，而是忠诚与背叛之间的选择。我们知道而你不知道的是，无论哪种情形，死亡都将随之而来。正如我们先前所说，我们不犯错。让你活着才会是个错误。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“不……不！你们答应过……你们答应过……我做了什么……？”船长此时已在啜泣。[PARAGRAPH:1]“真是好笑的话。我们发现，一个背叛者本该更明白，不该要求他人信守承诺。”[PARAGRAPH:1]那黑暗身影取下一直挂在背上的一根法杖，不理会啜泣的船长，径直将它笔直向下捅入船中。一道暗紫色的光芒闪现，当船长透过噙满泪水的双眼再度抬头时，它们已然消失，连同它们的船，只留下一个笔直贯穿船身的巨大破洞，船只很快开始进水。当其余船员在船上四处奔忙、惊慌失措、徒劳地试图自救时，船长只是双膝跪在那裂口前，想着他所毁掉的性命，想着塞蕾娜，想着自己的愚蠢，一心渴望着那能了结他苦难的波涛。[PARAGRAPH:1]正如它们当时知晓而他不知晓的，他与其船员的苦难其实并未将要终结。它才正要开始。

english: The Doviello carry crude weapons into battle, a throwing rock bigger than a man's head or a stout branch. They use these makeshift weapons because they were temporary. The first opponent killed becomes their weapon of choice. Grabbed by the ankles, they would be swung like a meaty flail. Blood sprayed over opponents, and every swing would lose more and more of the corpse, until another was needed to replace the first. At this point in the battle, the "weapons" were always readily available. Occasionally, an opponent would be grabbed while still alive. The effect of being beaten by a bloody body that was screaming at you while it happened is traumatizing to even the most hardened warrior. Few armies were willing to face even a few hundred Doviello.[PARAGRAPH:1]Saverous was a Doviello warrior, captured by the Burnt Priest and transported to an asylum where he could be the subject of experiments. He would have died there, or worse, gone months without death, but a war began. The Undertow searched their slaves for useful bodies, warriors were sacrificed, priests were pulled from their work to fight. Saverous was nearly 9 feet tall, his body still strong, even if his mind was broken from the experiments. They made him into a thrull.[PARAGRAPH:1]Possessed by a demon and inscribed with runes that hardened his skin and strengthened his muscles, Saverous was loosed on the battlefield, and Arawn help any man who stood in his way.
chinese: 多维洛带着粗陋的武器上阵——一块比人头还大的投掷石，或一根粗壮的枝干。他们用这些临时凑合的武器，是因为它们本就是临时的。第一个被杀死的对手会成为他们的首选武器。抓住脚踝，将其像血肉连枷一样挥舞。鲜血喷溅到对手身上，每一次挥舞都会甩掉尸体的越来越多的部分，直到需要另一个来替换第一个。到了战斗的这个阶段，这类“武器”总是唾手可得。偶尔，会有一个对手在还活着时就被抓住。被一具在挨打时还朝你尖叫的血淋淋的躯体殴打，其效果即便对最坚韧的战士也是创伤性的。鲜有军队愿意面对哪怕数百名多维洛。[PARAGRAPH:1]萨维罗斯曾是一名多维洛战士，被焚祭祭司俘获，转送到一处疯人院，好让他成为实验的对象。他本会死在那里，或者更糟——数月不得一死，但一场战争爆发了。深渊霸主在他们的奴隶中搜寻有用的躯体，战士被献祭，祭司被从其工作中抽调去作战。萨维罗斯身高近 9 英尺，即便心智已被实验摧毁，其躯体仍旧强健。他们把他造成了一个傀儡奴。[PARAGRAPH:1]被恶魔附身，刻上使其皮肤硬化、肌肉强健的符文，萨维罗斯被放上战场，阿拉温保佑任何挡他去路的人。

english: Saverous will only join Undertow civilizations. Saverous is a powerful warrior with a high strength and a built in bonus against melee troops; he frequently leads the Undertow into battle.
